data.gender_notes: Cherrita is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew words 'cher' (grace) and 'rita' (gift). In Christian tradition, Cherrita is considered a name for girls blessed with divine grace and gifted with the blessings of God. The name Cherrita carries the meaning “Blessed with grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cherrita usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cherrita total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
